data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'adl, meaning 'justice' or 'fairness'. In Islamic history, the term is often used to refer to the balance and equilibrium maintained by Allah in His creation. The name Adlea carries the meaning “Justice, fairness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adlea usually hope their child will grow to embody justice, fairness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
